Total jd 0 Proceed To Checkout View Cart Protected Areas Home Protected Areas Dana Biosphere Reserve Established in 1989, Dana Biosphere Reserve is Jordan’s largest and first biosphere reserve, according to UNESCO classifications in 1998. Covering some 292 km2 of rugged and beautiful landscape along the face of the Great Rift Valley. It sweeps down in a series of mountain ridges, from the 1500m high plateau near Quadesiyya to the desert plains of Wadi Araba. The mountains are cut by many steep-sided wadis, often lined with a lush growth of trees and shrubs. Its geology is as varied as i... Discover more Dana Biosphere Reserve is a unique place, learn more about it's features and activities Location Where is Dana Biosphere Reserve located? Ajloun Forest Biosphere Reserve Established in 1987, Ajloun Forest Reserve covers an area of 12 km 2 located in the Ajloun highlands north of Amman. It consists of Mediterranean-like hill country, ranging from 600 - 1100 m a... Discover more Ajloun Forest Reserve covers 12 square kilometers, learn more about it here! Location Where is Ajloun Forest Reserve located? Shaumari Wildlife Reserve In 1975, RSCN began fencing areas within Shaumari in preparation for the first wildlife protection reserve in Jordan, covering an area of 21 km2 . Shaumari Reserve acted as the first model reserve in Jordan’s dry desert climate Discover more Shaumari Wildlife Reserve is a unique place, learn more about it's features and activities Location Where is Shaumari Wildlife Reserve located? Azraq Wetland Reserve In 1978, RSCN established Azraq Wetland Reserve to conserve the uniquely precious oasis located in the heart of Jordan’s eastern desert, between a limestone desert in the west and a basalt desert in the east. It has an area of 74 km2 . Discover more Azraq Wetland Reserve has a big number of animals and plant species, learn more about it here. Location Where is Azraq Wetland Reserve located? Burqu Nature Reserve Established in the year 2018 and is located in in the North-Eastern Badia within Mafraq Governorate's borders. Its suggested northern borders are located around 12km's away from the Jordanian-Syrian borders, approximately 200 km's east the capital Amman. Discover more The reserve represents the most important areas for bird migration in Jordan. Learn more about Burqu Nature Reserve h... Location Where is Burqu Nature reserve located Dibeen Forest Reserve In 2004, the Royal Society for the Conservation of Nature RSCN established Dibeen Forest Reserve in northern Jordan, making it one of the Jordan’s most important forest nature reserves. The reserve lies within the Dibeen mountainous forest range and covers an area of approximately 8.5 km².... Discover more The structure of the forest as a whole is remarkably varied with trees of widely different ages and sizes, learn more... Location Where is Dibeen Forest Reserve lcoated Fifa Nature Reserve Fifa was declared a reserve in 2011, and is located in the southwest of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. It is 140 km south of Amman and its western border is the international border between Jordan and The West Bank. Discover more It is protected from reaching 420m. Learn more about the reserve here Location Where is Fifa Nature Reserve located Mujib Biosphere Reserve Established in 1987, Mujib Biosphere Reserve covers an area of 212 km 2 Bordering the Dead Sea at 402 meters below sea level, the Mujib Biosphere Reserve surro... Discover more The Mujib Reserve is located on one of the most important bird migration routes in the... Location Where is Mujib Biosphere Reserve located Yarmouk Forest Reserve Explore the captivating Yarmouk Forest Reserve, a true treasury of biodiversity nestled in Jordan. With its abundant greenery and diverse wildlife, the reserve proudly hosts a remarkable 27% of the country's bird population. Yarmouk Forest Reserve invites you to experience the magic of Jordan's extraordinary natural diversity in a setting of natural forest beauty. Discover more 18 species of mammals have been recorded through rapid survey studies, the most important of which is the Arabian gaz... Location Where is Yarmouk Nature reserve located Dahek Nature Reserve Dahek Nature Reserve was established in the year 2018, located in the North-Eastern Badia within Zarqa Governorate's borders. Its suggested southern borders are located 500m away from the Jordanian-Saudi borders Discover more The Valley of the Laughter shows evidence of an ancient sea. 55 million years ago.
